fields.Name: Organization Member Activity Summary
fields.Description: Skip analytics conversation from the More Cheese suite

fields.Message: For each organization with 5 or more member employees, show me the organization name, member count, and their combined event and course activity. Display as a table ranked by total activity. Let me click on an organization to see who the members are and their individual activity. [NO CHAT]

Here you go, your Organization Member Activity Ranking leaderboard is ready, powered by Organizations, Member Profiles, Event Registrations, and Course Enrollments. It displays qualifying organizations with 5 or more employee members ranked by their combined event and course engagement, along with top-level KPI summary cards. You can click any organization row to expand its member roster and see individual activity breakdowns, or drill directly into organization and person profiles.
